schema: authoring presets; not automatically loaded by Minecraft

power_charge.frame_selection: min(3, floor(age / ticks_per_frame)) for one-shot; floor(age / ticks_per_frame) % 4 for loop
power_charge.lighting: full brightness for energy; normal world lighting for smoke
power_charge.alpha: fade out in final frame; use alpha blending
